title: Calculator Interface & Form Submission
user_story: As a user, I want to see two number inputs, a way to pick one of the four basic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide), and a Calculate button on a single-page plain HTML UI served at the root route /, so that I can easily enter my calculation request.
acceptance_criteria: The app serves the plain HTML calculator interface at the root route /
The page contains exactly two input fields for numbers
The page includes a way to pick one of the four basic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide)
A Calculate button is present and submits the form data to the server

title: Server-Side Computation & Result Rendering
user_story: As a user, I want submitting the form to compute the result server-side and re-render the page with the result in a labeled area, so that I can see the correct answer immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting the form triggers server-side computation of the selected operation
The page re-renders after submission displaying the calculated value
A clearly labeled result area shows the numeric output
Original input values and chosen operation remain visible on the updated page

title: Input Validation & Error Handling
user_story: As a user, I want clear feedback when inputs are invalid or operations fail, so that I can correct mistakes without confusion.
acceptance_criteria: Entering non-numeric characters in number fields prevents calculation and displays an error message
Leaving any required field empty shows a prompt to fill in missing values
Attempting division by zero displays a clear warning instead of crashing the app
